title: Adjusted coefficient-field presentation
statement: Let k be a field of characteristic p>0 and Λ an Artinian local k-algebra, with residue field K, and assume H₁(L_{K/k}) finite dimensional over K [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. There exist a ring homomorphism σ:K→Λ sectioning the residue map, a finite subset t of Λ whose ideal span is the maximal ideal, and a finite subset c of K such that the image of every a∈k lies in the subring generated by t∪σ(k(c)). Moreover the k-subalgebra generated by t∪σ(K) is all of Λ. The containment is in ring closure, not k-algebra closure.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Hopkins–Levitzki to get IsNoetherianRing Λ. IsNoetherian.noetherian supplies a Finset t spanning the maximal ideal. Apply isArtinianRing_iff_isNilpotent_maximalIdeal to get its nilpotence.
Apply the fixed-generator coefficient-adjustment claim [lem-weil-pbc-nilpotent-coefficient-adjustment] to this t and nilpotence, obtaining σ,c, the section identity, and the ring-closure containment.

Put S=adjoin_k(t ∪ range σ), f:S→Λ the inclusion, m the maximal ideal, and J=m.comap f. Because t lies in S and spans m, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap and Ideal.mem_map_of_mem give J.map f=m. Ideal.le_comap_pow and injectivity of the inclusion show J nilpotent from m nilpotent. For any nilpotent ideal I with I^N=0, completeness is elementary: separatedness follows at N and every compatible Cauchy sequence converges to its Nth term. Equip S and Λ with their J-adic and m-adic completeness. The section σ lands in S, so the map S→Λ/m is surjective. Apply Mathlib surjective_of_mk_map_comp_surjective to f. Its surjectivity means S=top, proving the final clause, independently of characteristic, cotangent homology, or the finite coefficient containment. Combine the four clauses with the selected witnesses.

lean.statement: theorem exists_artinian_coefficient_presentation (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ] [IsArtinianRing Λ] [IsLocalRing Λ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hH : Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ) (H1Cotangent k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ))) : ∃ (σ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ →+* Λ) (t : Finset Λ) (c : Finset (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)), (IsLocalRing.residue Λ).comp σ = RingHom.id _ ∧ Ideal.span (t : Set Λ) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ ∧ (∀ a : k, algebraMap k Λ a ∈ Subring.closure ((t : Set Λ) ∪ σ '' (IntermediateField.adjoin k (c : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)) : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)))) ∧ Algebra.adjoin k ((t : Set Λ) ∪ Set.range σ) = ⊤
